facts.fact: The Conseil de gouvernement approved draft law n° 046.26 on the national statistical system on 2 July 2026, presented by the Interior Minister, setting a new legal framework for the system; no parliamentary adoption is stated.

facts.fact: Law 046.26 on official statistics was promulgated by dahir of 28 July 2026 and published in the Bulletin officiel of 10 August 2026, but per Medias24 as relayed by Canal212 it enters into force only at the first meeting of the deliberative organ of the future Conseil national de l'information statistique.
